paper_title: Novel cosmological bounds on thermally-produced axion-like particles
notes: Bounds derived from Planck 2018 CMB data combined with BAO measurements using novel cosmological constraints on thermally-produced axions. The limit shown is the observed 95% CL upper bound on the axion-photon coupling as a function of axion mass (Planck 2018 + BAO, blue diamonds in Figure 7). Data points extracted from Figure 7 of the paper. These are the most stringent cosmological bounds on the axion-photon coupling for m_a >= 3 eV, superseding CAST constraints in this mass range. The bounds are derived by constraining the effective number of relativistic species (ΔN_eff) from CMB observations and converting to axion-photon coupling limits via Eq. (3.5). Seven mass points extracted from the figure (m_a = 10^-4 to ~10 eV); the paper also studied m_a = 30, 100 eV which are beyond the visible axis range shown.
